protocol.caveat: Native internal energy-only endpoint with explicit same-basis seed handoff. Not a public CLI feature, force benchmark, GPU run, large system, or auto-promotion claim.
protocol.electrons_field_semantics: Restricted per-spin electron count (alpha=beta); density array is total AO density.
protocol.ordering: Within each case, process order alternated/rotated by repeat; first and second native calls retained separately
protocol.target: PBE0/RKS, 25% exact exchange + 75% PBE exchange + 100% PBE correlation
protocol.thermal_definition: First and second native endpoint in each fresh process. Both recreate all plans and grids; warm means process/library warm, not reused converged SCF or prepared plan. Process launch overhead excluded from endpoint and measured separately.
